caption_fb:
Follow Karen, Episode 2, the finale (an example family)

Stanley's draft card said Rzepiennik (zheh-PYEN-neek), near Tarnów.

The problem: four villages share that name.

The key was the name from the passenger list. Only one parish book had a baptism in May 1888 of a Stanisław whose father was Jan.

Karen's next step was an email to that parish, in Polish, with the English beside it so she knew what she was sending.

From "somewhere in Poland" to one village, one parish, one record. That's why we say: write down every name, even the ones that seem unimportant.

The whole method, step by step: Find Your Polish Village in 30 Days
